Rejected: the kernel template fails open again and the six cases go red. Recommendation: (b), unless the owner wants the lifecycle hooks to fail closed too. The ticket and DEC-880 item 3 cover only the guard and containment lines, and (a) adds a risk of Stop or SubagentStop looping. Confidence: medium.
